Sales Order

Footer templates allow you to add standard text sections at the bottom of your sales orders.

Create multiple footer templates to use for different types of sales orders, ensuring consistent communication with customers.

Name
Name

Footers appear at the bottom of your sales orders, providing important order confirmation details and terms to customers.

Common footer content includes:

• Delivery schedules and shipping information

• Cancellation and return policies

• Warranty terms and conditions

• Order modification procedures

• Customer acknowledgment requirements

Using Footer Templates

You can create multiple footer templates and select the appropriate one when creating each sales order.

This ensures consistent communication while allowing flexibility for different order types.

Enter a descriptive name for each footer template to easily identify its purpose, such as 'Rush Order Terms' or 'Custom Manufacturing Orders'.
